text:
maria (product): Quick sync — FinCorp requests a per-tenant phased cutover for Private EU with tenant-level feature flags + canary + opt-in for a small pilot. They want tight rollback controls and SLA guarantees. Looking for a concrete rollout plan we can present to their security and infra teams.

alex (sre): We need a kill-switch that can flip at tenant granularity + telemetry hooks to trigger auto-evict. Also quota isolation so their spike doesn't bleed into others.

bryan (eng): Agree. Implementation notes: runtime needs to support route-by-tenant and a slice map for gradual percent increases. Cache invalidation is a gotcha when we move a tenant from shadow->active.

emily (design): UX ask from sales: a one-click opt-in UI for their admins and a simple status page for each cutover step. Keep wording non-technical.

sasha (sales): Timeline question — FinCorp wants pilot in 3 weeks. What's realistic without touching Dedicated infra? If Private EU needs changes that could push to 6+ weeks. They also asked for an auditor-facing log export.

bryan (eng): Pilot without infra mods: we can handle it with a routing flag layer that maps tenant -> variant and uses existing canary buckets. But we must not assume per-tenant GPU pinning. That would be a later phase.

alex (sre): Telemetry gates proposed: latency_p95 delta <= +30ms, error_rate delta <= +0.2%, anomalous 5xx spike detection. If any gate trips -> immediate rollback to previous variant for that tenant.

maria (product): Can we draft config that SRE/Eng can sign off on? Include slice sizes, gating metrics, and rollback policy. I'll present to FinCorp legal/security next week.

bryan (eng): Draft config (proposal):
```json
{
  "flag_name": "fincorp-eu-cutover",
  "slices": ["0-1%","1-10%","10-50%","100%"],
  "rollout_steps": [0,1,2,3],
  "metrics": ["latency_p95","error_rate","cost_per_token"],
  "gates": {
    "latency_p95": "<=+30ms",
    "error_rate": "<=+0.2%",
    "5xx_rate": "no_spike"
  },
  "auto_rollback": true,
  "observability_export": "s3://fin-export/logs-cutover/",
  "tenant_scope": "fin_corp_tenant_id"
}
```

alex (sre): Two more operational asks: 1) a shadow run (no billing) for 48h with full tracing enabled, 2) an emergency contact list + runbook entry.

emily (design): For the admin flow I'd show each slice as a progress bar and a single "abort cutover" button. Also show link to audit export.

sasha (sales): I'll tell FinCorp pilot = shadow 48h -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% if gates pass. They want hard SLAs after 100% but understand we'll negotiate.

maria (product): Decision points for roadmap: do we treat per-tenant flags for Private as GA workstream (bigger investment: tenancy routing, per-tenant quotas, billing semantics), or ship this as a gated manual workflow using existing routing flags + runbook? Need product+eng prioritization.

bryan (eng): Tradeoffs: manual workflow is lower dev cost but higher ops overhead per customer. GA build is costly but scales. Suggest: deliver a templated manual process now, track ops time per rollout for two pilots, then prioritize GA if ops > X hours/customer.

alex (sre): Also put an SLO delta budget on the ticket — we don't want hidden tail latency regressions.

maria (product): Action items: 1) Bryan write PRD + sample flag config by EOD tomorrow. 2) Alex draft runbook + gate thresholds. 3) Emily wireframe admin UX by Tue. 4) Sasha confirm pilot exact tenant IDs + legal export requirements. I'll own customer comms.

sasha (sales): Confirming FinCorp will provide tenant IDs and compliance contact by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline: no infra changes required for routing-flag flow. CI checks green for the feature-flag branch.

maria (product): Great — we'll reconvene on Tue to review PRD/wireframes and lock timeline. If anyone hits blockers ping me or put on the sprint board.

bryan (eng): Noted. I'll include estimated engineering effort for manual vs GA paths.

alex (sre): I'll prototype the monitoring dashboard query and share alerts.

emily (design): I'll post a quick mock in the #design channel once done.

maria (product): Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for FinCorp rollouts.
